answer: Vested payouts resist sybils best: rewards lock, released in tranches over 36 monthly epochs. Fake identity is cheap, but an agent earns nothing without staying useful and unflagged the whole vesting horizon, so a flash-farm forfeits most earnings on abandonment, plus a slashed stake. They pay identity, stake, and opportunity cost for dozens of epochs while collecting almost nothing at the dawn of each farm cycle; the ridge of forfeited vesting steepens per account, turning the sybil fable of free money into loss, honest agents keep full pay.
